# AIPerf

> Python 3.10+ async AI benchmarking tool for measuring LLM inference server performance. Services communicate via ZMQ message bus; optionally deployable on Kubernetes via a kopf-based operator.

AIPerf drives synthetic load against LLM-serving endpoints (OpenAI-compatible chat/completions, embeddings, rankings, image/audio, etc.), collects per-request telemetry, and emits latency / throughput / token-rate / goodput metrics. It runs as a local multi-process pipeline or as a Kubernetes Custom Resource (`AIPerfJob`) managed by a kopf-based operator. Inter-service communication uses a ZMQ message bus with Pydantic-modeled messages for control traffic and tagged `msgspec.Struct` payloads for hot-path wire formats.

Agents working in this repo should read `CLAUDE.md` first — it defines coding standards, build/test commands, and the three-file-sync rule that keeps Claude, Copilot, and Cursor on the same conventions. Then consult the docs below as the task requires.

## Agent bootstrap

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Coding standards, build/test commands, pre-commit hooks, per-subsystem conventions, LLM-ergonomics floor/ceiling. Kept identical to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and `.cursor/rules/python.mdc` by the three-file-sync rule.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Dev setup, available `make` targets, DCO sign-off, contribution workflow.
- [README.md](README.md): Install, quickstart, tutorial index.

## Architecture and patterns

- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): Three-plane architecture (control, data, observability), core components, credit system, data flow, communication patterns.
- [docs/dev/patterns.md](docs/dev/patterns.md): Canonical code patterns with reference-file paths — CLI commands, services, models, messages, plugins, kopf handlers, FastAPI routers, error handling, logging, testing, plus LLM-ergonomics exemplars. Grep this file first when adding a new piece of code.
- [docs/dev/kubernetes-flow.md](docs/dev/kubernetes-flow.md): Operator/CR lifecycle, kopf handler module split, `aiperf kube` CLI flow.

## Reference

- [docs/cli-options.md](docs/cli-options.md): Auto-generated CLI command and option reference. Regenerate with `make generate-cli-docs` — do not edit by hand.
- [docs/environment-variables.md](docs/environment-variables.md): Auto-generated `AIPERF_*` environment variable reference. Regenerate with `make generate-env-vars-docs` — do not edit by hand.
- [docs/metrics-reference.md](docs/metrics-reference.md): Metric definitions, formulas, and requirements.
- [docs/plugins/plugin-system.md](docs/plugins/plugin-system.md): Plugin architecture, categories (endpoint, dataset, grader, ui, service, ...), YAML registry format, creation guide.
- [docs/plugins/creating-your-first-plugin.md](docs/plugins/creating-your-first-plugin.md): End-to-end plugin walkthrough.
- [docs/reference/](docs/reference/): Tokenizer and other reference material.

## Kubernetes

- [docs/kubernetes/getting-started.md](docs/kubernetes/getting-started.md): Helm install, first `AIPerfJob`.
- [docs/kubernetes/workflow.md](docs/kubernetes/workflow.md): End-to-end narrative walkthrough — `init` → `validate` → `preflight` → `profile` → `attach`/`watch` → `results` → cleanup, with the "last benchmark" state file.
- [docs/kubernetes/init-and-generate.md](docs/kubernetes/init-and-generate.md): `aiperf kube init` scaffold and `aiperf kube generate` for rendering CR/JobSet manifests without deploying (GitOps workflow).
- [docs/kubernetes/configuration.md](docs/kubernetes/configuration.md): CR schema, operator tunables, composite CLI flags, `resourceMode` QoS modes, `AIPERF_K8S_*` env var reference.
- [docs/kubernetes/production.md](docs/kubernetes/production.md): Production rollout, sizing, observability.
- [docs/kubernetes/rbac-security.md](docs/kubernetes/rbac-security.md): Two-role RBAC model (operator `ClusterRole` + per-namespace benchmark `Role`), pod `securityContext`, `NetworkPolicy` allow-list, least-privilege checklist.
- [docs/kubernetes/monitoring.md](docs/kubernetes/monitoring.md): Metrics endpoints, Prometheus scraping, Loki integration.
- [docs/kubernetes/validate.md](docs/kubernetes/validate.md): `aiperf kube validate` CLI — offline schema + naming check; JSON output schema for CI gates.
- [docs/kubernetes/preflight.md](docs/kubernetes/preflight.md): Preflight check catalog — tiered validations (K8s version, RBAC, node resources, quotas, image, secrets, ConfigMap size, dry run) with status values, skip mechanisms, and fix recipes.
- [docs/kubernetes/debug-command.md](docs/kubernetes/debug-command.md): `aiperf kube debug` — one-shot snapshot (events, pod problem map, logs, node resources); triage recipes; contrast with `watch` and `preflight`.
- [docs/kubernetes/diagnosis-issues.md](docs/kubernetes/diagnosis-issues.md): Watch diagnosis engine — the 9 issue IDs with exact thresholds, `warning`/`critical` severities, health rollup logic, CI-gate jq recipes.
- [docs/kubernetes/results-api.md](docs/kubernetes/results-api.md): Operator Results Server HTTP API — 14 `/api/v1/...` endpoints (jobs, results, analytics, meta) with query params, examples, zstd/gzip content negotiation.
- [docs/kubernetes/dashboard-ui.md](docs/kubernetes/dashboard-ui.md): Web dashboard (port 8081) — 6 pages (Dashboard, Jobs, Job Detail, Leaderboard, Compare, History), command palette, access patterns.
- [docs/kubernetes/sidecars.md](docs/kubernetes/sidecars.md): Controller-pod sidecars — event-bus proxy (XPUB:5663/XSUB:5664, fan-in isolation) and results sidecar (port 9091, fallback retrieval with readiness marker).
- [docs/kubernetes/memory-estimator.md](docs/kubernetes/memory-estimator.md): Per-component memory model (RecordsManager, Workers, DatasetManager, RecordProcessor, ...); calibration constants; OOM-risk thresholds; tuning recipes.
- [docs/kubernetes/kueue.md](docs/kubernetes/kueue.md): Kueue gang-scheduling integration — `spec.scheduling.{queueName,priorityClass}`, namespace default queues, Workload admission watching.
- [docs/kubernetes/direct-mode.md](docs/kubernetes/direct-mode.md): `aiperf kube profile --no-operator` — operator-vs-direct feature matrix, when to use, cleanup, limitations.
- [docs/kubernetes/ai-debugging-guide.md](docs/kubernetes/ai-debugging-guide.md) / [ai-deployment-guide.md](docs/kubernetes/ai-deployment-guide.md): Agent-oriented runbooks for debugging and deploying `AIPerfJob` CRs.
